tasks.title: Establish the architecture contract
tasks.acceptance: Define domain boundaries, model applicability, time/unit/conservation and coupling contracts, provenance and lawful-input controls, producer/evaluator separation, result/failure semantics, reproducibility, local recovery, security boundaries and measured scale triggers without claiming scientific implementation.

tasks.title: Establish the outcome and dependency roadmap
tasks.acceptance: Add Wave 0 and four-level programme logic while preserving all original 24 task IDs, acceptance criteria, wave numbers and dependency edges; identify critical constraints, evidence gates, cut order and replanning triggers.

tasks.title: Establish the executable next-work packet and repository-plan validation
tasks.acceptance: Define a bounded VR-001 packet with explicit public benchmark selection questions and justified acceptance, and provide a dependency/DAG/status/navigation validator that supports maintainer promotion of foundation tasks from READY_FOR_REVIEW to DONE.

tasks.title: Define the benchmark and clinical scope
tasks.acceptance: Record the exact publication, variables, units, applicable population, numerical tolerances justified by the source, and excluded clinical uses; obtain a qualified review before clinical interpretation.

tasks.title: Audit model and data rights
tasks.acceptance: Record release, license, redistribution permission, model limitations and public/synthetic provenance; no restricted or patient-level data enters the fixture.

tasks.title: Create the local experiment skeleton
tasks.acceptance: After the exact dependency review, implement CLI validation and a tiny synthetic smoke fixture; malformed units and unknown fields fail with a clear error.

tasks.title: Implement the physiology adapter
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce the fixed reference trajectory within the predeclared tolerance and report solver/version metadata.

tasks.title: Implement the event-time scheduler
tasks.acceptance: A hand-computable queue example matches expected waiting times; simultaneous events have a stable ordering.

tasks.title: Specify and test model coupling
tasks.acceptance: Prove unit/time conversion, reject unsupported actions and show uncoupled versus coupled traces without hidden state changes.

tasks.title: Build the synthetic cohort generator
tasks.acceptance: Generate bounded synthetic parameters with explicit distributions and seeds; no invented representativeness claim.

tasks.title: Run paired care-delay scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Use the same cohort and random inputs for both arms; retain all runs including failures and unknown applicability.

tasks.title: Export the first study report
tasks.acceptance: A fresh checkout regenerates tables, curves, sources and limitations; every clinical-sounding claim links to its evidence scope.

tasks.title: Add sensitivity and identifiability checks
tasks.acceptance: Show which parameters affect the result and which cannot be estimated from the selected data.

tasks.title: Separate calibration and validation
tasks.acceptance: Freeze a holdout before optimization and detect leakage; report prediction error by supported cohort slice.

tasks.title: Test numerical and physiological failures
tasks.acceptance: Representative unit errors, nonconvergence and impossible states cause explicit invalid results rather than favorable scores.

tasks.title: Reproduce one disease-response model
tasks.acceptance: Select a publicly reusable model and reproduce its published behavior without asserting therapeutic efficacy.

tasks.title: Reproduce an immune or vaccine-response model
tasks.acceptance: Use public aggregate model inputs, predeclared endpoints and a qualified review; retain the no-sequence/no-pathogen-engineering boundary.

tasks.title: Add liver and trauma-process research scope
tasks.acceptance: Independently validate a hepatic model and an abstract trauma-workflow case; document why neither establishes a surgical protocol.

tasks.title: Implement source-grounded hypothesis proposals
tasks.acceptance: Every hypothesis cites an approved source and declares the measurable prediction and falsifier; unsupported medical claims are rejected.

tasks.title: Add budgeted experiment selection
tasks.acceptance: Compare agent proposals with a fixed search baseline using equal evaluation budgets and untouched holdouts.

tasks.title: Add independent result checking
tasks.acceptance: A separate evaluator reproduces selected candidates and flags selective reporting or altered metrics.

tasks.title: Build the local study comparison view
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard-accessible baseline/candidate comparison exposes uncertainty, sources, invalid results and simulation-only status.

tasks.title: Add isolated batch workers
tasks.acceptance: Cancellation and timeout terminate subprocesses; interrupted studies resume without duplicate terminal results.

tasks.title: Package portable research bundles
tasks.acceptance: Another machine can inspect the bundle offline and reproduce a supported benchmark without private credentials.

tasks.title: Replicate two distinct scenarios
tasks.acceptance: A contributor who did not author the adapter reproduces two cases; discrepancies remain visible.

tasks.title: Review scientific interpretation and usability
tasks.acceptance: Qualified reviewers check supported claims and a researcher completes the import-run-compare-export flow.

tasks.title: Prepare the research preview release
tasks.acceptance: Publish only after maintainer approval; include evidence, dependency notices, known gaps and an explicit non-clinical-use statement.
